statements.select:
SELECT A.CUST_CD , A.CUST_NM FROM T_CUSTOMER A LEFT JOIN T_KEYMAN B ON A.COMPANY_CD = B.COMPANY_CD AND A.CUST_CD = B.CUST_CD WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#
AND A.USER_CD = #user_cd#
GROUP BY A.CUST_CD, A.CUST_NM ORDER BY CUST_NM ASC

SELECT CUST_CD , CUST_NM , (SELECT DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(MAX(SA_SDATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM T_SALES_ACTIVITY WHERE CUST_CD = A.CUST_CD AND USER_CD = A.USER_CD AND SA_TYPE IN (SELECT CODE_ID FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'SA_TYPE' AND VALUE_5 = 'Y') AND SA_BODY IS NOT NULL) AS LAST_VISIT_DATE , BAD_AR_YN FROM T_CUSTOMER A WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND A.CUST_CD = #cust_cd#
ORDER BY CUST_NM ASC

SELECT PJT_CD, PJT_NM FROM T_PROJECT WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND CUST_CD = #cust_cd#
ORDER BY PJT_NM ASC

SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(SA_CD) FROM T_SALES_ACTIVITY WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND USER_CD = A.USER_CD AND SUBSTRING(SA_SDATE, 1, 6) = A.SEARCH_YM AND SUBSTRING(SA_EDATE, 1, 6) = A.SEARCH_YM AND PLAN_YN = 'Y' ) AS CNT_1 , ( SELECT COUNT(SA_CD) FROM T_SALES_ACTIVITY WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND USER_CD = A.USER_CD AND SUBSTRING(SA_SDATE, 1, 6) = A.SEARCH_YM AND SUBSTRING(SA_EDATE, 1, 6) = A.SEARCH_YM AND PLAN_YN = 'Y' AND SA_BODY IS NOT NULL ) AS CNT_2 , ( SELECT COUNT(SA_CD) FROM T_SALES_ACTIVITY WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND USER_CD = A.USER_CD AND SUBSTRING(SA_SDATE, 1, 6) = A.SEARCH_YM AND SUBSTRING(SA_EDATE, 1, 6) = A.SEARCH_YM AND PLAN_YN = 'N' AND (CUST_CD != '' AND CUST_CD IS NOT NULL) AND SA_BODY IS NOT NULL ) AS CNT_3 , ( SELECT COUNT(SA_CD) FROM T_SALES_ACTIVITY WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND USER_CD = A.USER_CD AND SUBSTRING(SA_SDATE, 1, 6) = A.SEARCH_YM AND SUBSTRING(SA_EDATE, 1, 6) = A.SEARCH_YM AND SA_BODY IS NOT NULL AND (CUST_CD != '' AND CUST_CD IS NOT NULL) ) AS CNT_4 FROM (SELECT #user_cd# AS USER_CD, #search_ym# AS SEARCH_YM) A

SELECT SA_SDATE + isnull(SA_SDATE_TIME,'000000') AS START_DATE , SA_EDATE + isnull(SA_EDATE_TIME,'233000') AS END_DATE , SA_SUBJECT , SA_CD , SA_TYPE FROM T_SALES_ACTIVITY WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND USER_CD = #user_cd# UNION ALL SELECT SA_SDATE + isnull(SA_SDATE_TIME,'000000') AS START_DATE , SA_EDATE + isnull(SA_EDATE_TIME,'235959') AS END_DATE , SA_SUBJECT , A.SA_CD , 'SATYPE_999' SA_TYPE FROM T_SALES_ACTIVITY A, T_SA_CWUSER B WHERE 1=1 AND A.COMPANY_CD = B.COMPANY_CD AND A.SA_CD = B.SA_CD AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.USER_CD = #user_cd#

SELECT 'SA'+SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR, GETDATE(), 112), 3,2)+CONVERT(VARCHAR, REPLICATE('0', 6-LEN(ISNULL(MAX(CONVERT(NUMERIC, SUBSTRING(SA_CD, 5, 6))),0)+1)))+''+CONVERT(VARCHAR, (ISNULL(MAX(CONVERT(NUMERIC, SUBSTRING(SA_CD, 5, 6))),0)+1)) AS SA_CD FROM T_SALES_ACTIVITY

, SA_BODY
, NEXT_SA_SDATE , NEXT_SA_EDATE , NEXT_SA_TARGET , NEXT_SA_SUBJECT , USE_YN , REG_DT , REG_USR , PLAN_YN , CMT_YN , SA_COMMENT ) VALUES ( #company_cd# , #sa_cd# , #sa_type# , #sa_cnct# , #user_cd# , #dept_cd# , DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(#sa_sdate#, 'YYYYMMDD') , DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(#sa_edate#, 'YYYYMMDD') , #sa_sdate_time# , #sa_edate_time# , #cust_cd# , #pjt_cd# , #sa_subject#
, #sa_body#
, DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(#next_sa_sdate#, 'YYYYMMDD') , DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(#next_sa_edate#, 'YYYYMMDD') , #next_sa_target# , #next_sa_subject# , #use_yn# , getdate() , #reg_usr# , #plan_yn# , #cmt_yn# , #sa_comment# ) ELSE UPDATE T_SALES_ACTIVITY SET SA_TYPE = #sa_type# , SA_CNCT = #sa_cnct# , SA_SDATE = DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(#sa_sdate#, 'YYYYMMDD') , SA_EDATE = DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(#sa_edate#, 'YYYYMMDD') , SA_SDATE_TIME = #sa_sdate_time# , SA_EDATE_TIME = #sa_edate_time# , CUST_CD = #cust_cd# , PJT_CD = #pjt_cd# , SA_SUBJECT = #sa_subject#
, SA_BODY = #sa_body#
, NEXT_SA_SDATE = DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(#next_sa_sdate#, 'YYYYMMDD') , NEXT_SA_EDATE = DBO.FN_GET_DATE_FORMAT(#next_sa_edate#, 'YYYYMMDD') , NEXT_SA_TARGET = #next_sa_target# , NEXT_SA_SUBJECT = #next_sa_subject# , USE_YN = #use_yn# , MOD_DT = getdate() , MOD_USR = #mod_usr# , CMT_YN = #cmt_yn#
, SA_COMMENT = #sa_comment#
WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND SA_CD = #sa_cd#
